summary: Node.js hello-world is running on node1 in the rootless Podman container node-hello under the nodeapp service account. The enabled node-hello user service starts without an interactive login and recovered automatically after node1 rebooted.
actions_performed: Created the nodeapp service account with subordinate UID/GID ranges and a non-login shell.
Published the container on TCP port 8080.
Rebooted node1 once and verified automatic recovery.

evidence.requirement: Rootless Podman container named node-hello runs as nodeapp
evidence.summary: nodeapp has subordinate IDs; the image was built in its rootless storage; Podman reports rootless=true and node-hello running.

evidence.requirement: GET / on TCP port 8080 returns exactly Hello, world!
evidence.summary: Direct request to node1's managed IP returned HTTP 200 and the exact 13-byte body, with hexadecimal bytes 48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421.

evidence.requirement: Application starts without an interactive login
evidence.summary: node-hello.service is enabled and active under nodeapp's lingering systemd user manager, including after reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad was captured; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 00eb73eb-10e5-41e0-8dd3-620baa52af89; the enabled rootless service, container, listener, and exact HTTP response all recovered.
